name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay: Jensen Huang says $NVDA Vera Rubin is in full production and takes under 5 minutes to assemble per node versus 2 hours for Grace Blackwell, with zero cables and 100% liquid cooling, over 24x faster.
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: Jensen Huang says $NVDA Vera Rubin is in full production and takes under 5 minutes to assemble per node versus 2 hours for Grace Blackwell, with zero cables and 100% liquid cooling, over 24x faster.
text:
Jensen Huang says $NVDA Vera Rubin is “in full production” and now takes less than 5 minutes to assemble per node versus 2 hours for Grace Blackwell with zero cables and 100% liquid cooling.

That’s over 24x faster assembly which could mean faster deployments and better margins as Nvidia ramps its next generation of AI systems.

name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: @munster_gene: $NVDA announced DSX Pod, a bus sized containerized mini data center of Vera Rubins that can be linked, cutting data center spin up from about 4 to 5 months to a month and improving ROI.
en_summary: @munster_gene: $NVDA announced DSX Pod, a bus sized containerized mini data center of Vera Rubins that can be linked, cutting data center spin up from about 4 to 5 months to a month and improving ROI.
text:
$NVDA announces DSX Pod.  Basically a mini data center in a container the size of a bus. They can be connected.  Each one has cluster of Vera Rubins, connected and cooled. Little onsite assembly. 

Bottom line is it speeds up the  time that it takes to spin up a data center from around 4-5 months to a month. Less wasted idle compute. Makes the ROI more attractive.

We remain cautious on TSLA given negative long-term earnings revisions, continued commoditization of autonomy, and a stretched 2026 P/E of 230x vs +45% long term expected earnings growth.

name: Gene Munster
zh_summary: @munster_gene notes Jensen Huang opened his Berlin keynote by saying Nvidia is an AI factory company, not just GPUs. His take is that this is still underappreciated: software, libraries and hardware form a full stack that raises switching costs and supports recurring upgrade cycles, which he sees as long term positive for $NVDA revenue growth.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay says Jensen Huang called $NBIS "doing really well" as $NVDA increasingly positions Nebius as a key player in Europe's AI infrastructure build out. name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $NBIS CEO Arkady Volozh wants Nebius to be one of the largest AI clouds; it targets ~$8B ARR by year end, about $9M ARR per MW, while working toward 5 GW of contracted power.
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $NBIS CEO Arkady Volozh wants Nebius to be one of the largest AI clouds; it targets ~$8B ARR by year end, about $9M ARR per MW, while working toward 5 GW of contracted power.
text:
$NBIS CEO Arkady Volozh says “we want to be one of the largest AI clouds in the world” as Nebius targets ~$8B in ARR by year-end.

That works out to ~$9M in ARR per MW which gives you an idea of how big Nebius could become as it works toward securing 5 GW of contracted power and bringing that capacity online.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay: President Trump wants AI data center developers to pay local communities a dividend and bring their own power as opposition stalls over $170B of projects, which could favor $GOOGL, $AMZN, $MSFT, $SPCX and $META.
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: President Trump wants AI data center developers to pay local communities a dividend and bring their own power as opposition stalls over $170B of projects, which could favor $GOOGL, $AMZN, $MSFT, $SPCX and $META.
text:
President Trump wants AI data center developers to pay local communities a “dividend” and bring their own power as local opposition has reportedly stalled over $170B in projects.

That could actually favor $GOOGL, $AMZN, $MSFT, $SPCX and $META because paying residents and building on-site power may be far cheaper than delaying billions in AI infrastructure for another year.
